titulo_es: A conclusion with limits · Scientific results and reserves

texto: Read what the study measured, what it shows and with what limitations. «Tyder på» expresses an indication; «viser» may sound more conclusive, but the scope depends on the method.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
